section: India - industrial regions and industrial belts; factors of localisation
subsections: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: AKIC — Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor and NW-1
accepted.x: The Amritsar-Kolkata Industrial Corridor is built on the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor and the National Waterway-1 inland waterway system.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate corridors associated with the wrong freight route.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor is primarily associated with which of the following combinations?
o: ADB and the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor
JICA and the East Coast Economic Corridor
Japan and the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor
accepted.x: DMIC is backed by Japan and is built along or uses the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor.
accepted.tq: Use the corridor-partner and freight-route combination rather than identifying either feature in isolation.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor:
1. Its Andhra Pradesh node is Krishnapatnam North.
2. The node covers 10,834 acres.
3. The estimated cost associated with the node is ₹2,139 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Krishnapatnam North is the Andhra Pradesh node of CBIC, covering 10,834 acres with an estimated cost of ₹2,139 crore.
accepted.tq: Check whether all three numerical and locational details belong to the same corridor node.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct sequence of the VCIC-related facts?
o: Visakhapatnam-Chennai — about 800 km — first phase of East Coast Economic Corridor — ADB
Visakhapatnam-Chennai — about 800 km — first phase of Western Economic Corridor — JICA
Chennai-Bengaluru — about 800 km — first phase of East Coast Economic Corridor — Japan
Amritsar-Kolkata — about 800 km — first phase of East Coast Economic Corridor — United Kingdom
accepted.x: VCIC is the approximately 800-km Visakhapatnam-Chennai corridor, regarded as the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor, with ADB as its partner in the cited corridor framework.
accepted.tq: Match the corridor name, length, larger corridor and partner as one linked unit.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In the Andhra Pradesh component of the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor, which of the following figures is associated with the ADB loan?
accepted.x: The ADB loan associated with the Andhra Pradesh component of VCIC is ₹3,300 crore.
accepted.tq: Separate the loan figure from the total project cost and from other corridor-related allocations.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following combinations correctly describes the Andhra Pradesh node of the Hyderabad-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor?
accepted.x: Orvakal in Kurnool is the Andhra Pradesh node of HBIC, covering 2,621 acres with an estimated cost of ₹1,781 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the two Andhra Pradesh corridor nodes by location, area and cost.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following industrial corridors is associated with the Act East link to ASEAN?
accepted.x: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is associated with the Act East link to ASEAN.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive strategic feature to distinguish VCIC from the other corridors.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Corridor)
A. CBIC
B. VCIC

List-II (Partner or description)
1. ADB

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the National Industrial Corridor Programme is correct?
1. It comprises 11 national industrial corridors.
2. After the approval of 12 new industrial smart cities in August 2024, the number of projects became 20.
3. Its implementation involves NICDC and NICDIT.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: The programme comprises 11 corridors; approval of 12 new industrial smart cities raised the project count to 20, and implementation involves NICDC and NICDIT.
accepted.tq: Test the programme through its scale, August 2024 expansion and implementing institutions.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NICDC was formerly known by which name, and in which month and year was it incorporated?
accepted.x: NICDC was formerly DMICDC and was incorporated in January 2008.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the present institutional name, the former name and the date of incorporation.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NICDC functions under which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
accepted.x: NICDC functions under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who would do this job?’ method to identify the administrative ministry.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Budget 2026-27 proposed an integrated East Coast Industrial Corridor with a node at which place?
accepted.x: The integrated East Coast Industrial Corridor proposed in Budget 2026-27 includes a node at Durgapur under the Purvodaya initiative.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the newly proposed budget node from existing Andhra Pradesh corridor nodes.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched in relation to Defence Industrial Corridors?
o: Tamil Nadu — Chennai, Coimbatore and Hosur
Tamil Nadu — Madurai, Salem and Tiruchirappalli
Uttar Pradesh — Chitrakoot, Kanpur and Lucknow
Uttar Pradesh — Aligarh, Agra and Jhansi
accepted.x: The Tamil Nadu Defence Industrial Corridor has Chennai, Coimbatore, Hosur, Salem and Tiruchirappalli; Madurai is not listed among its five nodes.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped or substituted node in the corridor list.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about India’s Defence Industrial Corridors:
1. The Uttar Pradesh corridor has six nodes.
2. The Tamil Nadu corridor has five nodes.
3. Together, the two corridors have investment commitments of ₹74,756 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Uttar Pradesh corridor has six nodes, the Tamil Nadu corridor has five nodes, and the two together have investment commitments of ₹74,756 crore.
accepted.tq: Combine node-count and investment figures, checking whether the aggregate statement is also supported.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.s: India’s first Defence Industrial Corridor was announced along which stretch?
accepted.x: India’s first Defence Industrial Corridor was announced along the Chennai-Bengaluru stretch.
accepted.tq: Avoid confusing the first Defence Industrial Corridor with the names of major economic corridors.
accepted.sec: Industrial corridors - DMIC, CBIC, VCIC, AKIC, BMEC, Defence corridors, NICDC nodes  [APPSC]

accepted.x: Gurugram is an automobile centre associated with Maruti Suzuki. Panki is associated with fertilisers, Visakhapatnam with shipbuilding and steel, and Modinagar with rubber.

accepted.s: Sivakasi is noted for which of the following industries and regional location?
o: Fireworks, matches and printing; Madurai-Coimbatore-Bengaluru region
Aluminium and steel; Chota Nagpur region
Coal and thermal power; Hyderabad-Bengaluru region
